Package com.robojacks.lib.sim

Class SimHardware

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.sim.SimHardware
All Implemented Interfaces:
Hardware
public class SimHardware extends Object implements Hardware
Desktop stand-in for the brain. Motors are first-order (voltage -> speed with lag) with static friction, time runs as fast as the CPU allows, and you script the competition mode and controller from a sim main().

Sensors are plain objects your sim script can set (sim.getDistanceSensor(5).distanceMeters = 0.3) or tie to the simulated robot: simulateTankDrive(int[], int[], double, double) tracks the robot's true pose, which the GPS reads and tracking wheels (simulateTrackingWheel(int, boolean, double, double)) follow. The brain screen is drawn into an image you can save with SimHardware.SimScreen.save(java.lang.String).

    • simulateTrackingWheel

      public void simulateTrackingWheel(int port, boolean forward, double offsetMeters, double wheelDiameterMeters)
      Makes a Rotation Sensor act as an unpowered tracking wheel on the simulated robot.
      Parameters:
      port - the Rotation Sensor's port
      forward - true for a wheel that rolls forward/back, false for one that rolls sideways
      offsetMeters - for a forward wheel: how far left of center (+) it is; for a sideways wheel: how far in front of center (+) it is
      wheelDiameterMeters - tracking wheel diameter
